== Answers and leads ==
Post an answer to any open case here: name the case (for example "2023 group photograph, no. 20" or "2000 Toola Regionals"), give the answer, and say how you know. An editor adds it to the article with you as the source and moves the case to [[Mysteries#Solved]]. == About the hub ==
[[Help Complete the Archive]] was built on 25 November 2026 (swccg-guild/work#1357). Live counts come from the [[Template:Mystery]] type categories; list-based counts live in [[Template:Archive open cases]] and are updated when the lists change. The featured case rotates through [[Template:Featured mystery]]. [[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]] ([[User talk:Comlink Cursor|talk]]) 15:24, 25 November 2026 (UTC)

== SWCCG Forum and section pictures ==
How-to-help now points people to the [https://swccg.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=4 General board] of the [https://swccg.com/forum/ SWCCG Forum] first, then to Talk pages. The Players Committee forum and Slack are no longer listed as ways to send an answer. Each section also has a photograph or product image already on the wiki.
